constraints.1_security_non_negotiable: No service_role key in any agent, workflow, or environment variable exposed to frontend. JWT auth only (ai_reader / ai_writer roles).
constraints.2_gdpr_gate: DPIA must be signed by Patrick before ANY live email mining begins (Wave 2A). Bulk-embed (Wave 1A) may proceed after DPIA is signed.
constraints.3_no_traveltree_replacement: TravelTree must remain the source of truth for itinerary data. CRM reads and creates via API only — never replicates or replaces TT data.
constraints.4_staff_always_in_control: No client-facing action (email send, proposal share, booking confirm) without explicit staff approval click. AI suggestions only.
constraints.5_cost_ceiling_wave3a: $8 one-time exception for @dnd-kit + TanStack + Kanban dependencies (D26). No other paid dependencies without Patrick sign-off.
constraints.6_eu_data_residency: All data stays in Supabase eu-central-1 Frankfurt. No data egress to US-based services for PII processing.
constraints.7_unverified_default: All AI-enriched records default to status: unverified. Staff must touch a record to change status.
constraints.8_soft_delete_only: Never DROP rows from deal_embeddings. Use active=false. Hard delete only via erase_contact_pii() GDPR function.
constraints.9_azure_sql_untouched: FinnConcierge's existing 9 Azure SQL tables are NOT touched by CRM build. CRM lives entirely in the new Supabase project.
constraints.10_booking_reference_server_side: FDM-[6-char alphanumeric] booking references generated server-side only. Never client-generated, never UUID exposed to staff.

auto_escalate_to_patrick: Any decision that modifies the 8 security requirements in SHARED-CONTEXT.md
Any schema change that requires dropping a column or table (migrations should only ADD)
DPIA scope changes (new data categories, new LLM providers, new retention periods)
TravelTree API behavior differs from documented T1/T2 spec
Agent produces output that would be client-visible (emails, proposals) without explicit approval gate
BUILD-STATE.md shows a wave marked done but machine-checkable criteria not confirmed
A discovered KC invalidates a prior wave done state
LLM/infra cost for any wave exceeds its budget by >20%
do_not_escalate: SQL migration column ordering — use best practice
shadcn/ui component selection — use established pattern
n8n node configuration details — implement per WAVE-BUILD-AGENTS.md
